scope: Owned source-copy inspection; no extension execution, Store/service request, or current-app compatibility certification
filter_setup: Semantic text replacement; palette focus; native IME hide; stable actual closed-IME geometry. This is not physical typing or a pointer-hide claim.

clear_glyph_pixels.pixel_probe_scope: Four diagonal and four axis neighborhoods of the actual 18dp clear glyph; not a full-image comparison

clipboard_scope: No clipboard reads or writes in this class; host independently restores/verifies its durable recovery snapshot
